lights.intent: the alcove wash that makes the armarium the landmark

the east reading room's own pool

props.intent: the open armarium standing in the alcove cut for it, on the artery's sightline: the archive's face to the visitor
vaulting down over the western range - the damage story starts where the traffic is thinnest
a spall off the same fall
another spall, further into the aisle
the first dropped roll of the trail east

the spill widening
a fallen beam across the aisle between the ranges
its stool, still upright
the first press of the western range, still full
its neighbour, half-emptied: the evacuation reached this bay
a shuttered press - the bay nobody opened
the range continues east, out of the nave's shadow
a rack of hung leaves, still drying in the east range
the long reading board of the east room - cover the player can use, dressed as furniture
the catalogue lectern where the exit corridor leaves the room
more of the same fall, on the south walk
masonry that fell from the parapet into the garth
a stack set down beside the walk and never picked up
